body:
The left bank changes faster than it can settle into habits. New blocks fill up an entire stairwell at a time, office towers rise between them, Khan Shatyr and Abu Dhabi Plaza stand nearby, and in the evening people drift out to walk along the Ishim River embankment. There is plenty of work here and rather less time. And almost nowhere you can sit down at nine in the evening and order breakfast instead of dinner. Frnds at 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street works exactly that way: the kitchen keeps making breakfast for as long as the door is open.

We mix our pizza dough ourselves — every day, in the amount we expect to use. It is the dullest part of the job and the most important one: the crust depends on it, the way the toppings behave depends on it, and so does whether the pizza is still good once you have carried it home. Alongside pizza there is pasta, panuozzo, soups, salads and desserts. The bar lives a life of its own: mornings are mostly specialty coffee, in the afternoon people order iced tea or lemonade with something hot, and evenings call for our own tea blends, the kind you do not want to finish quickly. Smoothies and milkshakes usually arrive with dessert, or instead of it.

People come here for all sorts of reasons. After a walk along the embankment, when the wind has cleared your head and it suddenly turns out you are hungry. After work — the two of you, or a small group, to split a pizza and take your time: you have until eleven at night. On a Sunday when no alarm went off, you left the house closer to noon and still count it as morning — so, breakfast and coffee, never mind the daylight outside. Sometimes people stop in just for a cup of coffee on the way back to the car, and that is a perfectly good reason too.

The address is simple: 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street, Esil district. Open every day from 09:00 to 23:00, no days off. You can sit in the dining room or take your food with you. If you want to check something in advance, like what is in the desserts today, write to us on WhatsApp: +7 707 480 92 15. What the kitchen is up to shows up on Instagram, @frnds.kz. The rest is better checked in person, at a table.
cta: If you find yourself somewhere on the left bank today, head for 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street: we are open from nine in the morning until eleven at night.
h1: Frnds: pizzeria and coffee shop on Astana's left bank
landmarks: Look for us at 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street — Esil district, the left bank. Khan Shatyr, Abu Dhabi Plaza and the Ishim River embankment are all on this side of the river.
seo_description: Frnds — pizzeria and coffee shop on Astana's left bank: pizza on our own dough, pasta, coffee. 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street, daily 09:00–23:00.
